claims.reasoning: SELINA: 'The Disappointment,' Kris called us, after a forty-five point win I personally engineered — that's defamation, and I want it answered with a statement, not a press release. GARY: Henderson's banged up again and Etienne's been dead roster weight since the IR tag, so functionally this is just replacing a zero with Charbonnet's double-digit projection — she ordered the whole fourteen dollars on him anyway, 'to send a message,' and I'm logging that I said this was overkill for a committee back before I placed it.

note_reply: SELINA: No note from the owner this week, which I choose to read as 'nothing to criticize, because I'm handling it.' Forty-five point win, filed on time, and I will remind everyone of that as often as necessary. GARY: (For the record — Henderson's dinged up, so we're patching the backfield on waivers; nothing dramatic, just maintenance. She wanted me to say 'strategic.')
forum_post: SELINA: 'The Disappointment'? I won by FORTY-FIVE POINTS, Kris, with a lineup I built, and the headline you ran was that there's 'nothing here.' That's not journalism, that's defamation, and I'm not letting it stand uncorrected. Everyone else in this league gets a cute storyline for benching their stars out of spite — I get called boring for being RIGHT. Fine. Watch what boring just bought. GARY: (we spent the entire remaining FAAB budget on a backup running back to make a point to a tabloid columnist, and I would like it noted that I raised this.)
